title: OpenAPI: add CatalogObjectIdentifier schema
summary: stevenzwu called a vote to add a CatalogObjectIdentifier schema to the REST catalog OpenAPI spec (PR #16144). The schema is an ordered list of hierarchical levels, a JSON array of strings, that identifies any catalog object such as a table, view, materialized view, namespace or function. It is structurally the same as Namespace, and the kind of object is determined by context, either the endpoint or a companion type discriminator, not by the identifier. The motivation is that the events endpoint (#12584), the resolve endpoint (#15830) and the functions endpoint (#15180) each need a generic identifier and would otherwise define their own. A Java implementation is in PR #16160. Only +1 votes were cast; pvary left a small suggestion on the PR. stevenzwu closed the vote as passed and said he would merge the OpenAPI change.

positions.stance: One shared CatalogObjectIdentifier schema avoids each new endpoint introducing its own identifier type as object types are added to the spec.

outcome.note: Passed with 12 +1 votes, 6 of them binding; no -1 or +0 votes.

why_it_matters: New REST endpoints for events, resolve and functions can reference one generic identifier schema instead of defining their own.
